// Named like a unit test, but reaches the real emulator and mints real tokens.
process.env.NODE_ENV = 'local';

const { db } = require('../../src/utils/firebase');
const { mintRealUser } = require('../helpers/real-auth');

test('a real caller is authorised', async () => {
  const user = await mintRealUser({ uniqueId: 1 });
  await db.doc(`users/${user.uniqueId}`).get();
});
